title: @bradenslen Do not write of Drupal. @swentel has made amazing progress and it sounds like it has everything you are looking for. I went with a hybrid
summary: @bradenslen Do not write of Drupal. @swentel has made amazing progress and it sounds like it has everything you are looking for. I went with a hybrid approach, a few static pages and a Known site. I think this would work for you as well. I also think you could go all in on micro.blog
